Definition: properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil
BiblicalUsage: 1) to toil, labour, grow weary, be weary; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to toil, labour; 1a2) to grow weary, be weary; 1b) (Piel) to weary, make weary, cause to go toilsomely; 1c) (Hiphil) to make to toil, make weary, cause to be weary
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
